lines.text: Leave the pedal up once. Hear what the hands are doing.
An ornament needs somewhere to arrive. Do not hurry it just to get through.
Try the release at the harpsichord. Bring that knowledge back to the marimba.
Keep the first take. You need to hear what changed.
Cream case, a little rubbed at the corners. Debussy on the front; a brass winding key on the dark back plate. Clair de lune.
Lyle — one of the pianists — gave it to you before his big break. So you’d have something to remember him by.
